result.rationale: The evidence supports the same everyday device sense in both locales. Malaysia’s Dewan Bahasa dan Pustaka defines “komputer” as an electronic device that stores and processes information and lists “komputer riba” as a subtype (https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=54140&keyword=komputer). The audited Indonesian article uses “komputer” for the corresponding device. “PC,” “laptop,” and “komputer riba” do not establish a conflicting sense or national difference. The cited articles do not measure frequency or prove Malaysia-wide prevalence, but that limit does not undermine the proposed same-sense relation.
